cases.name: the-fact-reads-from-a-fields-embd-metadata
cases.covers: The fact reads from a field's /EMBD_Metadata, never with a group or on a signature field.

cases.name: fill-rights-sender
cases.covers: Every token that may fill in some field fills one in, and no other: sender.

cases.name: a-field-in-a-group-or-a-signature-field-is-never-for-anyone
cases.covers: A field in a group or a signature field is refused forAnyone; a group needs forAnyone: false with it; both move in one update; another tool's entry beside a group goes with the group.

cases.name: marking-one-takes-fields-set-group-all
cases.covers: A designer who sets Dana's group alone is refused marking a field by a create and an update, and unmarks one with form design.

cases.name: the-sender-marks-one-on-create
cases.covers: The sender, with fields:set-group:all, makes a field anyone fills in.

cases.name: an-undo-puts-the-fact-back
cases.covers: An undo puts the fact back, also after a later change to the field.

cases.name: an-undo-leaves-a-newer-assignment
cases.covers: An undo leaves a newer assignment as it is and puts the rest back, skipping forAnyone and groupId together.

cases.name: an-update-that-expects-the-fact
cases.covers: An update that expects forAnyone applies only where it holds.

cases.name: a-copy-keeps-the-fact
cases.covers: A copy keeps the fact for the sender; a designer who may not mark one is refused.

cases.name: a-copy-of-one-takes-the-right-to-mark-it
cases.covers: A designer who may not mark a field anyone fills in may not copy one.
